report: Reviewed the complete current claim, full spec_plan.rs implementation context, and the sole associated test. Independently verified exact byte equality of current spec_plan.rs with both historical implementation_sources and test_sources; historical approval is context, not execution evidence. The only implementation entry (sage_meta::todo) and test (sage_meta::todo::browser_searches_entities_and_combines_filters, test:spec_plan) are explicitly TODO. The empty test has no behavioral assertions and calls no helpers. Its comment explicitly defers named members, prose, model/Rust paths, combined filters, empty results and opening links outside the active results; file-level documentation explicitly defers both implementation and tests until their implementation stage lands. Thus all claim obligations remain deferred: matching names and qualified model paths, descriptive prose and Rust paths when available; combining crate and entity-kind filters with text; displaying result kind and owner with direct links including named members; showing no-match state; and preserving direct links through search/filter changes and opening entities outside the current results. Prerequisites are browser search/filter/result presentation and stable entity navigation implementation, followed by focused interaction assertions covering these scenarios, including optional Rust-path availability. A regression that drops prose matching or hides an entity behind a filter would not be detected by this stub; no claim of coverage is made. The explicit implementation/test TODO evidence adequately records this pending browser work; accepting it does not establish implemented behavior. No additional behavioral source dependencies were relied on. Read and captured review policy. Executed review start/read and byte comparison, then submitted this report via review record; no behavioral tests or builds were run by this reviewer. The coordinator's reported 321-test suite and cargo build success are separate baseline execution and do not establish deferred search behavior.
